props.name: height
props.description:
Vertical resizing, as in Figma auto layout. Unset keeps the element's usual height.
`"hug"` (Hug contents): as tall as its content, never grows or stretches.
`"fill"` (Fill container): in a column Stack it takes an equal share of the free height; it shrinks below its
content only when the column has a height of its own (Fixed, Fill or maxHeight), else it keeps its content height
(pass `minHeight={0}` for a scrolling child of a column sized from outside). In a row Stack it stretches to the
row's height; in a Grid cell it fills the cell (over alignSelf); in a plain block it takes 100% (the parent needs
a height).
A number: Fixed height in px, which does not shrink in a column Stack.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Minimum height in px (Figma min height). Wins over fill's shrink-to-0.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Maximum height in px (Figma max height).

props.name: position
props.description:
Figma "Ignore auto layout" (layoutPositioning ABSOLUTE). `"absolute"` takes the element out of its parent's flow
and pins it to the parent Stack, Grid, Box or Card with `constraintX` / `constraintY`; siblings, `gap`, `justify`
and the parent's Hug size ignore it, as in Figma. Siblings written after it paint above it (Figma auto layout
"Last on top"), so put background media first. Default `"static"` (in flow). Only Stack, Grid and Box take it:
wrap a Text or a component in a Box. Badges, status dots and a Card sub-action are component props, never insets.

props.name: constraintX
props.description:
Figma horizontal constraint, read only with `position="absolute"`: `left` (default, Figma Left) · `right` (Right)
· `left-right` (Left & right: stretches between the two offsets, `width` is ignored) · `center` (Center: exact
centre, the X offsets are ignored). Figma Scale is not offered (it needs percentages, which are not tokens).

props.name: constraintY
props.description:
Figma vertical constraint, read only with `position="absolute"`: `top` (default) · `bottom` · `top-bottom`
(Top & bottom: stretches between the two offsets, `height` is ignored) · `center` (exact centre).

props.name: insetTop
props.description:
Offset from the parent's top edge on Spacing/Padding (none 0 · 3xs 2 · 2xs 4 · xs 8 · sm 12 · md 16 · lg 20 ·
xl 24 · 2xl 32 · 3xl 40 · 4xl 48; Figma Y snapped to the padding ladder). Read only when `constraintY` pins the
top edge (`top`, `top-bottom`). Default none (flush). Measured from the parent's padding box, as Figma ignores the
frame's padding for absolute children.

props.name: insetRight
props.description: Offset from the parent's right edge on Spacing/Padding. Read only when `constraintX` is `right` or `left-right`. Default none.

props.name: insetBottom
props.description: Offset from the parent's bottom edge on Spacing/Padding. Read only when `constraintY` is `bottom` or `top-bottom`. Default none.

props.name: insetLeft
props.description: Offset from the parent's left edge on Spacing/Padding (Figma X snapped to the ladder). Read only when `constraintX` is `left` or `left-right`. Default none.

props.name: effectStyle
props.description:
Figma effect style (the whole style is the token, one per layer as in Figma). Drop shadows
(`Shadow/Bottom/Level-1…4`, `Shadow/Top/Level-1…4`) render only on `surface="surface"`, never on Subtle, Pale or
Surface-Alt (component-usage-rules §9) nor without a fill, and a shadowed surface takes no border (elevation follows
the Sidebar). `Shadow/Bottom/Level-1` is the Card (Theme=Shadow 7063:62203) and Sidebar elevation; the Top levels
cast upward for bottom-pinned bars (Bottom-Sheet 4059:14162 uses Top/Level-2). `Effect/Overlay` is the background
blur behind a translucent fill and renders only on `surface="subtle"` or `"pale"`. The shadows use the spread
tokens, which Figma draws on a filled, clipped frame: pair them with `clip` when children could overflow.

props.name: clip
props.description:
Figma "Clip content" (frame clipsContent): children are clipped to the box's padding box and its corner radius, so
full-bleed media or an absolute layer keeps the box's rounded corners. Uses `overflow: clip`, which makes no scroll
container (a sticky child still sticks to the page scroller). Default false (content may overflow).

props.name: radiusTopLeft
props.description:
Top-left corner on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma topLeftRadius; none · 2xs 2 · xs 4 · sm 8 · md 12 · lg 16 ·
xl 20 · 2xl 24 · 3xl 28 · full), following the radius mode. A set corner wins over `radius`, as `paddingX` wins
over `padding`; unset corners keep `radius`. Don't mix `full` with a finite corner (`radius="full"
radiusBottomRight="xs"`): `full` is Corner-Radius/Rounded (1000px), so the browser scales every corner down to fit
the box and the small one renders square. Use a finite radius (a chat tail: `radius="xl" radiusBottomRight="xs"`);
`full` mixes only with `none`.

props.name: radiusTopRight
props.description: Top-right corner on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma topRightRadius). Wins over `radius`.

props.name: radiusBottomRight
props.description: Bottom-right corner on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma bottomRightRadius). Wins over `radius`.

props.name: radiusBottomLeft
props.description: Bottom-left corner on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma bottomLeftRadius). Wins over `radius`.

props.name: surface
props.description:
Background layer (docs/guidelines/background-layers.md): `surface` for cards and panels on the Canvas page,
`surface-alt` on a white (Alt) canvas, `subtle` / `pale` for wells. Never Canvas (the page), Flat (navigation) or
Container (modals and sheets use Dialog / BottomSheet).

props.name: border
props.description: Closed-box border: `subtle` when the box is actionable, `pale` when it is static (docs/guidelines/borders.md).

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma cornerRadius, follows the radius mode); `radiusTopLeft` … `radiusBottomLeft` override single corners.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description:
Content width: sm 640 (forms) · md 960 (settings, reading) · lg 1280 (dashboards, default) · xl 1440 · full (list and
table pages: a page whose content is a non-widget Table spans the whole width, no max).

props.name: gutter
props.description: Page margin on both sides from the breakpoint tokens (24 desktop/tablet, 20 mobile). Default true.

props.name: width
props.description:
Horizontal resizing, as in Figma auto layout. Unset keeps the element's usual width.
`"hug"` (Hug contents): as wide as its content, never grows or stretches.
`"fill"` (Fill container): in a row Stack it takes an equal share of the space left after each child's padding
and may shrink to 0; in a column Stack it stretches across; in a Grid cell or a plain block it takes the full
width. Fill children in a wrapping row need a `minWidth` to wrap.
A number: Fixed width in px, which never shrinks in a flex row. Sizes include padding and border (border-box).
(Container's `maxWidth` is a different prop: a token width, sm…full.)
Prefer hug or fill; use Fixed only for widths that really are fixed (a side column, a preview frame).

props.name: minWidth
props.description: Minimum width in px (Figma min width). Wins over fill's shrink-to-0.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Maximum width in px (Figma max width), e.g. a readable line length for a Fill block of text.

props.name: alignSelf
props.description:
This element's alignment inside its parent: start · center · end · stretch across a Stack's
direction (vertical in a row, horizontal in a column), vertical inside a Grid cell. Overrides the parent's `align`
for this child. A `"fill"` size on the same axis still fills; in a column, alignSelf then places it once maxWidth
stops it. No effect outside a Stack or Grid.

props.name: height
props.description:
Vertical resizing, as in Figma auto layout. Unset keeps the element's usual height.
`"hug"` (Hug contents): as tall as its content, never grows or stretches.
`"fill"` (Fill container): in a column Stack it takes an equal share of the free height; it shrinks below its
content only when the column has a height of its own (Fixed, Fill or maxHeight), else it keeps its content height
(pass `minHeight={0}` for a scrolling child of a column sized from outside). In a row Stack it stretches to the
row's height; in a Grid cell it fills the cell (over alignSelf); in a plain block it takes 100% (the parent needs
a height).
A number: Fixed height in px, which does not shrink in a column Stack.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Minimum height in px (Figma min height). Wins over fill's shrink-to-0.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Maximum height in px (Figma max height).

props.name: textStyle
props.description: Figma text style, e.g. "Body/Base/Regular" (default), "Body/Small/Medium", "Caption/Regular", "Heading/4".

props.name: tone
props.description: Colour role: a Color/Content token by its path ("base", "support-blue-strongest"). Default strongest (primary text).

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render. Default p (a block); use span inside a line, label for a form label.

props.name: truncate
props.description: true: one line with an ellipsis; a number: clamp to that many lines. The full text stays in the DOM.

props.name: align
props.description:
Text alignment (Figma Alignment): "start" (left in LTR), "center", "end", or "justify" (both edges flush, Figma's
Justified: only for long paragraphs in a wide column; in a narrow one it opens gaps between words). Unset keeps the
parent's alignment. Inline text (as="span") aligns once it is a block or has a width.

props.name: verticalAlign
props.description:
Vertical alignment inside the box (Figma Align top / middle / bottom). It shows only when the box is taller than its
text: a Fixed or Fill `height` (Figma's Fixed size text box). Default top.

props.name: htmlFor
props.description: For `as="label"`.

props.name: width
props.description:
Horizontal resizing, as in Figma auto layout. Unset keeps the element's usual width.
`"hug"` (Hug contents): as wide as its content, never grows or stretches.
`"fill"` (Fill container): in a row Stack it takes an equal share of the space left after each child's padding
and may shrink to 0; in a column Stack it stretches across; in a Grid cell or a plain block it takes the full
width. Fill children in a wrapping row need a `minWidth` to wrap.
A number: Fixed width in px, which never shrinks in a flex row. Sizes include padding and border (border-box).
(Container's `maxWidth` is a different prop: a token width, sm…full.)
Prefer hug or fill; use Fixed only for widths that really are fixed (a side column, a preview frame).

props.name: minWidth
props.description: Minimum width in px (Figma min width). Wins over fill's shrink-to-0.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Maximum width in px (Figma max width), e.g. a readable line length for a Fill block of text.

props.name: alignSelf
props.description:
This element's alignment inside its parent: start · center · end · stretch across a Stack's
direction (vertical in a row, horizontal in a column), vertical inside a Grid cell. Overrides the parent's `align`
for this child. A `"fill"` size on the same axis still fills; in a column, alignSelf then places it once maxWidth
stops it. No effect outside a Stack or Grid.

props.name: height
props.description:
Vertical resizing, as in Figma auto layout. Unset keeps the element's usual height.
`"hug"` (Hug contents): as tall as its content, never grows or stretches.
`"fill"` (Fill container): in a column Stack it takes an equal share of the free height; it shrinks below its
content only when the column has a height of its own (Fixed, Fill or maxHeight), else it keeps its content height
(pass `minHeight={0}` for a scrolling child of a column sized from outside). In a row Stack it stretches to the
row's height; in a Grid cell it fills the cell (over alignSelf); in a plain block it takes 100% (the parent needs
a height).
A number: Fixed height in px, which does not shrink in a column Stack.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Minimum height in px (Figma min height). Wins over fill's shrink-to-0.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Maximum height in px (Figma max height).

props.name: level
props.description:
Document level (h1–h6): pick it from the page outline, not from the size. Step down one level at a time (h1 → h2
 → h3); going back up may jump (h4 → h2). Default 2.

props.name: textStyle
props.description:
Visual style; defaults to the level's ladder style (1 Heading/1 · 2 Heading/4 · 3 Heading/Subheading · 4
 Body/Extra/Bold · 5–6 Body/Base/Bold). A content h1 (the page title shown large) stays Heading/1 (harness:
 heading/h1-is-heading-1). Set textStyle when the kind of content asks for it: a card title is always
 Heading/Subheading, whatever its level; a list group header (a kicker) is Body/Small/Bold in tone "light".

props.name: tone
props.description: Colour role: a Color/Content token by its path, as on Text. Default strongest.

props.name: truncate
props.description: true: one line with an ellipsis; a number: clamp to that many lines. The full text stays in the DOM.

props.name: align
props.description: Text alignment (Figma Alignment), as on Text: start · center · end · justify. Unset keeps the parent's alignment.

props.name: verticalAlign
props.description: Vertical alignment inside the box (Figma Align top / middle / bottom), as on Text: shows with a Fixed or Fill height.

props.name: sidebar
props.description:
Left navigation, usually <Sidebar>. When the shell is 1024px or wider it sits beside the content, expanded or
collapsed to its rail; narrower, it opens as a modal drawer from the top bar's menu button.

props.name: header
props.description: Top bar content after the toggle (it grows): Breadcrumbs (Figma HR-Platform) or a Search.

props.name: headerActions
props.description:
Top bar actions on the right, in this order: a plan Badge, AppShellAction buttons (notifications, settings, help),
then the account menu (`<Menu trigger={<AppShellAccount … />}>`). Page actions belong in the PageHeader.

props.name: banner
props.description: A full-width message strip above the whole shell, usually <AlertBanner> (trial ending, maintenance, offline). It stays in view while the page scrolls.

props.name: aside
props.description:
A right panel docked beside the content (Figma Side-Panel), usually <SidePanel type="standard">. It docks while the
page keeps at least a Tablet width (744px) beside it; otherwise a SidePanel opens as the modal panel and other
content stacks under the page.

props.name: floatingAction
props.description: One floating button in the bottom-right corner of the page (Figma Floating-Item), e.g. an assistant IconButton. The end of the page keeps room for it.

props.name: footer
props.description: A sticky bar at the bottom of the main column, e.g. an ActionBar.

props.name: canvas
props.description: Page background layer: default Canvas, alt (a white page) or flat (pair it with Sidebar background="flat").

props.name: sidebarCollapsed
props.description: Sidebar rail state when controlled; pair it with `onSidebarCollapsedChange`.

props.name: defaultSidebarCollapsed
props.description: Initial rail state when uncontrolled. Default: the Sidebar's own `collapsed`, else expanded.

props.name: onSidebarCollapsedChange
props.description: Called when the toggle (or `useAppShell().setSidebarCollapsed`) collapses or expands the Sidebar. Store it (e.g. localStorage) to keep the choice between visits.

props.name: sidebarToggle
props.description:
The collapse toggle at the start of the top bar (Figma HR-Platform: icon-layout-left before the Breadcrumbs).
Default true: shown when the shell has a top bar (`header` or `headerActions`) and a Sidebar that can collapse.
A Sidebar with its own `onCollapsedChange` keeps its header control instead.

props.name: navOpen
props.description: Drawer state when controlled (narrow shells).

props.name: navLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation drawer. Default: the locale's “Navigation”.

props.name: mainId
props.description: id of <main>, the target of the "Skip to content" link. Default: a generated unique id.

props.name: layout
props.description: Force the layout. By default (`auto`) the shell's own width decides: narrower than 1024px uses the drawer. Force it only for previews and tests.

props.name: children
props.description: The page.

props.name: icon
props.description: Figma Leading-Icon: an icon name (`"icon-bell-01-line"`) or a node.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The action's name (“Notifications”): its accessible name, with the unread count added, and its 1s tooltip.

props.name: count
props.description: Figma Noti-type=Number: the unread count on a badge. 0 hides it; above 99 it reads "99+" (the accessible name keeps the exact number).

props.name: dot
props.description: Figma Noti-type=Dot: something new without a count. Hidden while a count shows.

props.name: tone
props.description: Figma Notification-Dot Theme: `default` Negative (needs attention) · `active` Positive · `accent`.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Figma Theme: `tertiary` (Button/Icon-Main Medium Tertiary, 40px) · `flat` (Button/Icon-Flat Medium Primary: a 20px glyph with a 40px hit area).

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip text. Default: `aria-label` (without the count).

props.name: name
props.description: The signed-in person's name: the accessible name (“Account: Ava Chen”), the tooltip and the initials without a photo.

props.name: src
props.description: Photo URL (Figma Avatar/Single Theme=Photo).

props.name: theme
props.description: Initials colour without a photo. Default neutral.

props.name: title
props.description: The page title (an h1 by default: one per page).

props.name: description
props.description: One or two sentences under the title.

props.name: breadcrumbs
props.description: Above the title: <Breadcrumbs> for nested pages.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Above the title when there are no breadcrumbs: a short section label.

props.name: actions
props.description: Page actions on the right of the title: Tertiary buttons first, then at most one Primary. They wrap under the title on narrow screens; on phones (ZenProvider breakpoint mobile) the Primary is shown first.

props.name: meta
props.description: Next to the title: a status Badge, Tag or AvatarStack.

props.name: tabs
props.description: Under the header: <Tabs> that switch the page's sections.

props.name: back
props.description: A Back control for detail pages (chevron icon, per the navigation rule).

props.name: headingLevel
props.description:
Heading level of the title. Default 1 (Heading/1, the Figma Master-Layout page title); 2 (Heading/2) only when the
 page already has an h1 (e.g. inside a tab). The text style always follows the level.

props.name: href
props.description: Destination URL. Required unless `as` renders a router link that takes its own destination prop (e.g. `to`).

props.name: external
props.description:
Opens the destination in a new tab: adds `target="_blank"`, `rel="noopener noreferrer"`, a trailing external-link icon
and a visually hidden “(opens in a new tab)” (in the locale's language), so the change of context is visible and announced. Use it for other
sites (docs, status pages, help centres), not for pages of the same app.

props.name: underline
props.description:
When the underline shows: `hover` (default; also on keyboard focus) for standalone links, `always` for links inside
running text so they never rely on colour alone, `none` only where the context already says it is a link
(a navigation list). Defaults to `always` when `tone="inherit"`.

props.name: tone
props.description:
Colour: `hyperlink` (default) uses Content/Hyperlink Default, Pressed while pressed and Visited (see `visited`);
`inherit` takes the surrounding text colour (footers, captions, legal lines) and is underlined by default.

props.name: visited
props.description:
Show the Content/Hyperlink/Visited colour once the destination has been visited. Default false: in-app links keep one
colour; turn it on for content links people scan repeatedly (search results, articles, docs). `hyperlink` tone only.

props.name: as
props.description:
Element or router component rendered instead of `<a>`, e.g. `as={RouterLink} to="/settings"` (React Router,
Next.js Link). Every other prop, the ref included, is forwarded to it.

props.name: children
props.description: The link text. Name the destination (“Billing settings”), never “click here”. The font comes from the surrounding Text.

props.name: trigger
props.description:
The control that opens the menu: a Button or an IconButton with an aria-label (it names the menu too). It receives
aria-haspopup="menu", aria-expanded and aria-controls, and the opening keys (Enter · Space · ↓ first item, ↑ last item).

props.name: items
props.description: The actions: items, `{ type: "separator" }` and `{ type: "group", label, items }`. Without it, compose `children`.

props.name: children
props.description: Composable entries (`MenuItem`, `MenuSeparator`, `MenuGroup`), used when `items` is not given.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the chosen item (after the item's own `onSelect`); then the menu closes and focus returns to the trigger.

props.name: align
props.description: Which edge of the trigger the menu lines up with: `start` (default) or `end` (a trigger at the right end of a row or card). Flips when it would leave the viewport.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state; pair it with `onOpenChange`. Default: uncontrolled and closed.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial state when uncontrolled. Default false.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with `true` when the trigger opens the menu and `false` when it closes (choice, Escape, Tab, outside press).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the menu. Default: the trigger's name (aria-labelledby).

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the floating surface.

props.name: id
props.description: Stable id, handed back to the Menu's `onSelect`. Default: the label.

props.name: label
props.description: The action, verb first (“Duplicate”, “Move to…”). One line: a long label ends in “…”.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon: an icon name (drawn at 20px) or an element. Give every item of a menu an icon, or none.

props.name: caption
props.description: A second line with a short consequence (“Anyone with the link can view”).

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keyboard shortcut shown on the right (“⌘D”). Display only: the app wires the shortcut itself.

props.name: danger
props.description: Destructive action (Delete, Remove): Content/Negative text. Put it last, after a separator.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Not available right now: dimmed and skipped by the arrow keys.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Runs when the item is chosen (click, Enter or Space); then the Menu's `onSelect` runs and the menu closes.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the row.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the line.

props.name: label
props.description:
Small label above the items (“Share”, “Move to”); it names the group for screen readers (aria-labelledby). It is a
 label, not a heading, so a menu never adds to the page outline.

props.name: children
props.description: MenuItem and MenuSeparator elements.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the group.

props.name: form
props.description:
The state from `useFormState()`. Form submits through `form.handleSubmit`: it validates, shows every error, moves
focus to the first invalid field and announces how many need attention. Pass either `form` or `onSubmit`.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description:
Your own submit handler, called after `preventDefault()` (e.g. react-hook-form's `handleSubmit(onValid)`). Return a
promise and Form waits for it; then, if any field is invalid (aria-invalid), it focuses the first one and announces the count.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between the form's direct children (Figma Spacing/Gap): the groups of a form. Default lg (24px); fields inside a group use md.

props.name: invalidMessage
props.description: Screen-reader message after a failed submit. Default: the locale's "1 field needs attention" / "3 fields need attention".

props.name: noValidate
props.description: Skip the browser's own validation bubbles; Zen shows errors under each field. Default true.

props.name: children
props.description: The groups of the form, top to bottom: Stacks or Grids of fields, FormFieldsets, and FormActions last.

props.name: label
props.description: The field label (Figma Input/Label, Body/Small/Regular). Omit it only when the control carries its own label (a Checkbox).

props.name: helpText
props.description: One line of guidance under the control (Help-Text, Neutral). Replaced by `error` while there is one.

props.name: error
props.description: The error message (Help-Text, Negative). Pass `form.fieldError(name)` so it shows at the right moment.

props.name: required
props.description: Adds " *" to the label and aria-required to the control. Mark the few optional fields instead when most are required.

props.name: optional
props.description: Figma Label `Optional`: appends "(Optional)".

props.name: labelTooltip
props.description: Figma Label `Tooltip-Icon`: an info icon with this text as a tooltip.

props.name: labelAction
props.description: Figma Label `Action`: a right-aligned link or text button ("Reset to default").

props.name: controlId
props.description: id given to the control (default: generated). The label points at it.

props.name: children
props.description:
Exactly one control. It receives `id`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid` and `aria-required`,
so it must put them on its focusable element (Slider takes aria-labelledby; your own controls should take all five).

props.name: legend
props.description: Names the group ("Delivery speed", "Email me about"); read before each option. Required.

props.name: hideLegend
props.description: Hide the legend visually (screen readers still read it) when a heading right above already names the group.

props.name: kind
props.description:
What the group holds. `radio` adds role="radiogroup" (with aria-required / aria-invalid), as the RadioButton
guideline asks; `toggle` spaces rows md; `checkbox`, `radio` and `group` space them sm. Default group.

props.name: direction
props.description: Stack the options (column, default) or lay them in a wrapping row (2–3 short options).

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between options (Figma Spacing/Gap). Default sm, or md for toggles.

props.name: helpText
props.description: One line of guidance for the whole group, under the options. Replaced by `error` while there is one.

props.name: error
props.description: The group's error ("Choose a delivery speed"). Pass `form.fieldError(name)`.

props.name: required
props.description: Adds " *" to the legend (and aria-required to a radio group): at least one option must be chosen.

props.name: optional
props.description: Figma Label `Optional`: appends "(Optional)" to the legend.

props.name: children
props.description: The options: Checkbox, RadioButton (sharing one `name`) or Toggle rows.

props.name: align
props.description:
Where the buttons sit on wide layouts: `end` (default, right), `start`, or `between` (the first child alone on the
left, e.g. "Delete draft", the rest on the right). Write Tertiary (cancel) first and Primary (submit) last in every case.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Keep the bar pinned to the bottom of the scrolling area (Surface background, Pale top line, safe-area padding).

props.name: inset
props.description: Sticky only: side padding of the bar, e.g. lg on a full-bleed phone screen so the buttons line up with the fields.

props.name: children
props.description: The buttons: Tertiary (cancel) first, Primary (`type="submit"`, named for the outcome) last.

props.name: items
props.description: The rows, in reading order. Or pass DescriptionItem children (both render, items first).

props.name: layout
props.description:
inline (default): term at the start and value at the end of one line (order summaries, specs); it stacks by itself
when the list is narrower than `stackBelow`. stacked: term above value (profiles, addresses, long values).

props.name: divider
props.description: Pale rules (Border/Neutral/Pale) between rows, with Padding/Small above and below each rule. Default false.

props.name: stackBelow
props.description:
Inline layout only: below this width (px) of the list itself the rows stack (term above value). Default 280, so
lists in phone cards and sheets (about 300–350px) stay inline while narrow columns stack; 0 keeps them inline.

props.name: children
props.description: DescriptionItem rows.

props.name: term
props.description: The label (dt): Body/Small/Regular, Content/Neutral/Base.

props.name: description
props.description: The value (dd): Body/Base/Medium, Content/Neutral/Strongest.

props.name: action
props.description: An action for this row only (rendered in its own dd at the end of the row).

props.name: emphasis
props.description: The total row: Body/Base/Bold with a High rule above it. One per list.

props.name: className
props.description: On the row's div (the dt/dd group).

props.name: position
props.description:
sticky (default): stays at the bottom of the scrolling area while the content above scrolls, and settles at the end
of it. fixed: pinned to the bottom of the viewport; an invisible spacer of the bar's height keeps the end of the page
reachable. static: in the flow, e.g. the last row of a card.

props.name: direction
props.description:
vertical (default): full-width stacked Large buttons, Primary on top; the phone footer for one main action.
horizontal: Tertiary then Primary side by side. On a bar 480px or wider (desktop) the summary sits at the start and
Medium buttons hug their labels at the end; on a narrower bar (a phone, a narrow panel) the summary takes its own row
and Large buttons split the next one equally (the Figma Bottom-Sheet dual footer), for two peer actions such as
Clear all · Show results.

props.name: surface
props.description:
default: Surface/Default with a Pale (Border/Neutral/Pale) top rule. alt: Surface/Alt with the same rule. none: no
fill and no rule, for a static bar inside a container that already has one. Never a drop shadow.

props.name: primaryAction
props.description: The one main action (level primary). Rendered first (top) when vertical and last (end) when horizontal.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.description: One alternative (level tertiary), next to the primary: below it when vertical, before it when horizontal.

props.name: summary
props.description: Context for the actions: a total, a selection count or a status line. Above the buttons when vertical, at the start when horizontal.

props.name: children
props.description:
Custom actions (Buttons, in visual order: Primary first when vertical, last when horizontal). With primaryAction /
secondaryAction they sit on the side away from the Primary.

props.name: radiusTopLeft
props.description:
Top-left corner on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma topLeftRadius; none · 2xs 2 · xs 4 · sm 8 · md 12 · lg 16 ·
xl 20 · 2xl 24 · 3xl 28 · full), following the radius mode. A set corner wins over `radius`, as `paddingX` wins
over `padding`; unset corners keep `radius`. Don't mix `full` with a finite corner (`radius="full"
radiusBottomRight="xs"`): `full` is Corner-Radius/Rounded (1000px), so the browser scales every corner down to fit
the box and the small one renders square. Use a finite radius (a chat tail: `radius="xl" radiusBottomRight="xs"`);
`full` mixes only with `none`.

props.name: radiusTopRight
props.description: Top-right corner on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma topRightRadius). Wins over `radius`.

props.name: radiusBottomRight
props.description: Bottom-right corner on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma bottomRightRadius). Wins over `radius`.

props.name: radiusBottomLeft
props.description: Bottom-left corner on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma bottomLeftRadius). Wins over `radius`.

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL. While it is undefined (the URL is still being fetched) the Skeleton shows.

props.name: alt
props.description:
Required text alternative: what the picture shows, in context ("Matte black pour-over kettle, side view"). Use ""
only for a decorative picture that repeats text next to it; never a file name or "image of…".

props.name: ratio
props.description:
Frame ratio (width : height): "1:1" · "4:3" · "3:2" · "16:9" · "3:4", or a number (2.35). The frame keeps its size
while loading, so nothing jumps. Unset: the picture's own ratio (4:3 while it loads or fails).

props.name: fit
props.description: cover (default): fills the frame and crops. contain: shows the whole picture on Neutral/Pale bars (logos, documents).

props.name: radius
props.description:
Corner radius on the Zen scale (Corner-Radius): none · 2xs · xs · sm · md (default, 12) · lg · xl · 2xl · 3xl · full.
`radiusTopLeft` … `radiusBottomLeft` override single corners (Figma per-corner radius, e.g. top media in a card:
`radius="none" radiusTopLeft="2xl" radiusTopRight="2xl"`); unset corners keep this radius (md by default).

props.name: loading
props.description: Native loading: lazy (default) waits until the picture nears the viewport; eager for the first picture on screen.

props.name: caption
props.description: A caption under the picture (Body/Small/Regular, Content/Neutral/Base); the picture becomes a figure with a figcaption.

props.name: className
props.description: On the root (figure or div).

props.name: style
props.description: On the root (figure or div).

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL. While it is undefined the Skeleton shows.

props.name: alt
props.description: Required text alternative. "" when the row already names the item (a ListItem title, a table cell label) next to it.

props.name: size
props.description:
Image-Size token: 3xs 16 · 2xs 20 · xs 24 · sm 32 · md 40 (default, a ListItem leading visual) · lg 48 · xl 56 ·
2xl 80 · 3xl 112 (compact density; comfortable scales them). Tables use sm with a caption, xs without.

props.name: shape
props.description: rounded (default: the radius steps with the size, like Avatar Square), circle, or square (no radius).

props.name: fit
props.description: cover (default) crops to the square; contain shows the whole picture (logos, app icons).

props.name: loading
props.description: Native loading: lazy (default) or eager.

props.name: className
props.description: On the root span.

props.name: style
props.description: On the root span.

props.name: as
props.description:
Element to render. Default span: inline, so it is valid inside buttons, links and table headers. Use div or p for a
block, h2–h6 for a heading that names a region only screen readers need, label (with htmlFor) for a hidden field
label, and a (with href and focusable) for a skip link.

props.name: focusable
props.description:
Shows the content while it, or a link or button inside it, has focus: a Surface pill (Body/Base/Medium, Subtle
ring) at the top-start corner of the nearest positioned ancestor, above the page. Use it for skip links. Default false.

props.name: href
props.description: With `as="a"`: the link target, e.g. "#main".

props.name: htmlFor
props.description: With `as="label"`: the id of the control it labels.

props.name: children
props.description: The text for assistive technology (and for the visible pill while a focusable one has focus).
